verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the core linking primitives — [[page]] links and (()) block references — used to connect notes, and community comments describe using Logseq as a networked 'second brain' with recall benefits, supporting the linking-graph theme in general. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents a backlinks panel or unlinked-references feature, so the 'see every backlink and unlinked mention in context' half of the story is unsupported. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the backlinks section and unlinked-references list on pages, and independent confirmation these display in context.
